items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I caught her off twice we just had a little taste in Copenhagen, but nobody was playing then

ctx.x: But would you classify her with Ethel?

Sometimes she gets off. I caught her off twice we just had a little taste in Copenhagen, but nobody was playing then... She slipped just a little bit but she never slipped too much. But Ethel Waters, I just love her.
